notes.title: Patch 0.0.4.6 - How to Play Screen & Smarter AI
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes – Version 0.0.4.6[/h1]
[h3]How to Play Screen[/h3]
Added a new How to Play info screen accessible from the options menu during combat.
Covers key mechanics like:
[list]
[*] How cards work
[*] The action system (Charge, Attack, Block)
[*] UI elements (card queue, card structure, etc.)
[/list]This screen will appear automatically once players finish the tutorial (returning players will have this screen appear once during their next fight)

[h3]AI Improvements[/h3]
Reworked enemy AI behavior:
[list]
[*] Enemies now make decisions based on the cards they currently have
[*] Should make enemies easier to predict and play against
[/list]
[h3]UI Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the position of tooltips to not cover the element they're referencing
[/list]
[h3]Balance Tweaks[/h3]
Adjusted the talismans used by The Healer:
[list]
[*] Vital Emblem, Sanctuary Mark and Heart of Gaia now heal less
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some freezing issues caused by fights ending due to card effects and not direct damage
[*] Fixed enemy characters not appearing as the correct chakra
[*] Fixed an issue allowing the player to Block after using a different action during long attack animations
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.3.5 – Shop Overhaul & Remote Config
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes – Version 0.0.3.5[/h1]

[h2]Game Data[/h2]
We’ve implemented a remote data system! [i]Sheva[/i] can now receive balance updates and content tweaks without needing a full new build.
[list]
[*] When you launch the game, it will automatically check for a new config file.
[*] You can still play offline with no issues—you just won’t get the latest changes until you’re back online.
[/list]
[h2]Shop Overhaul[/h2]
We’ve expanded and restructured the shop to give players more options—and better ones—as they progress.
[list]
[*] Cards: 3 → 5
[*] Powers: 3 → 4
[*] Talismans: 2 new ones added
[*] Healing Options Updated:
[list]
[*] Heal: Restores current HP
[*] Max HP: Increases max HP and restores current HP
[/list][*] Guaranteed rarities now scale with your progress (i.e. more chakras cleared = more powerful rewards)
[/list]
[h2]Cards & Talismans[/h2]
Removed ≤ and ≥ conditions from all cards and talismans
[list][*] This helps simplify effects and results in cleaner tooltips for everyone (devs and players alike).
[/list]
[h2]UI & Tooltip Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tooltips now show rarity for cards and items
[*] Chakra tooltips now include reward types to help you plan your path
[*] Updated regular enemy tooltips to better explain skipping mechanics
[*] General polish to keep things more thematic and more informative
[/list]
[h2]AI Improvements[/h2]

Smoothed out boss/enemy behavior so they don’t just stand around or go hyper-aggressive with every card

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Achievements are now working!![/b]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could queue actions while animations were still playing
[*] Fixed tooltip cutoff issues on certain screen resolutions
[*] Fixed a bug where animations continued playing when alt-tabbing
[*] Fixed the [b]Kindred Knot[/b] talisman so it now works only once per fight
(The Healer was getting way too comfy with his job)[/list]

notes.title: New Build
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.0.3.0 Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]Tutorial:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the tutorial with some (hopefully) better texts
[*] Added a pop-up that explains Chakras can be unlocked in any order
[*] Added a notification icon when the player earns new items
[/list]
[h2]Opponents:[/h2]
[list]
[*] All opponents had their attacks updated with effects that better match their chakra
[*] Removed some low rarity cards from higher level enemies
[*] Bosses now have talismans equipped
[/list] Overall enemies should provide more of a challenge

[h2]Cards:[/h2]
[h3]Guard:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of Guard cards have based on their rarity and increased their damage
[list]
[*] Common -50%
[*] Rare -30%
[*] Epic 25%
[*] Legendary 30%
[*] Increased the base damage of all cards with Guard effects by 10%
[/list][/list]
[h3]Conditions:[/h3]
Some card conditions that are harder to accomplish now provide a bigger bonus to their card’s effect
[list]
[*] HP≤25%
[*] Cards≥3
[*] Cards≥4
[/list]
[h2]Shop:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The ‘remove card’ option is now free to use each time player reaches a shop
[*] Players can remove a second card by spending currency
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The ‘Unravel’ card now removes the correct amount of cards when its activated
[*] Fixed the ‘Stun' effect not locking the Block action
[*] The skill icon is now disabled after using it during a turn, indicating it’s been used
[*] Fixed Cloud Saves not syncing between platforms
[*] The notification on the collection button now correctly disappears
[*] Purchasing the ‘Max HP’ upgrade in the shop now correctly adjusts current HP as well
[*] Sheva will no launch in full screen (and added a ‘windowed’ option in settings)
[/list]
[h1]Next Up:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We’re planning a rework of the shop that should affect which items/upgrades are available
[*] AI improvements!
[/list]
